a: أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَرَمِ وَالْحُزْنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
p: Aʿūdhu bika mina-l-harami wa-l-ḥuzni wa-l-ʿajzi wa-l-kasali wa-l-bukhli wa-l-jubni wa ḍalaʿi-d-dayni wa ghalabati-r-rijāl
m: I seek refuge in You from decrepitude and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from the weight of debt and from being overpowered by men.
